Garden plots for rent in the east of the city

Our association rents out garden plots on two sites, each with water taps and a shared tool shed for members to use.

Plots available this season

North site, small plot

Twenty square metres next to the main gate, with good sun for most of the afternoon.

South site, large plot

Waiting list

Prices for the season

The yearly fee covers water from April to October and the use of the shared shed on both sites. Members pay once in spring, and the fee is refunded in part if you give the plot up before the end of May.

Apply for a plot

Joining the waiting list

When every plot on a site is taken, new members are added to the waiting list in the order their application arrives. We send an email as soon as a plot comes free, and you then have two weeks to accept it or pass it to the next person on the list.

Most people on the list get a plot within one season, although the large plots by the river usually take longer because tenants tend to keep them for years.
